reason_for_42a_limit: At 10.8 V low-line, a 450 W electrical envelope requires 41.67 A. 42 A therefore covers the 400 W core thermal envelope plus a bounded auxiliary/fan allowance without treating the 50 A connector-path ceiling as a normal operating point.

measured_reference_linearized_wall_280w.classification: derived sensitivity from external measured BM1373 reference; not a FREEAXE measurement

electrical_qualification_envelope_450w.classification: engineering qualification envelope including bounded auxiliaries

connector.status: candidate; exact housing/header/terminal PN and connector temperature-rise qualification pending

fuse.location: upstream of board connector, as close to source as practical
fuse.thermal_rule: 42 A continuous envelope is accepted only while fuse ambient/body region remains <=85 C; above 85 C, current must be derated or fuse architecture requalified.
fuse.status: candidate; final time-current coordination and inrush measurement still required

transient_protection.tvs: required but part number intentionally unresolved until source surge/transient environment is defined
transient_protection.reverse_polarity: required; implementation intentionally unresolved pending loss/thermal analysis
transient_protection.bulk_capacitance: required near connector; value intentionally unresolved pending two-domain VRM transient model
transient_protection.inrush_control: required to be evaluated after bulk capacitance and hot-plug source impedance are known

distribution.topology: protected 12 V entry feeding two symmetric ASIC VRM input branches plus one auxiliary branch
distribution.branch_protection: per-branch protection/current limiting required; exact fuse/eFuse implementation unresolved until inrush and VRM startup are measured
distribution.note: branch current values are input-side electrical envelopes, not steady-state BM1373 claims

pcb_current_path.entry_strategy: short connector-to-protection region followed by a low-impedance split into two symmetric VRM branches
pcb_current_path.strategy: wide parallel top/bottom 12 V and return pours with dense via stitching; no neck-downs; reserve optional soldered copper strap/busbar footprints on common trunk and branch entries
pcb_current_path.branch_symmetry_requirement: keep connector-to-domain A and connector-to-domain B path resistance closely matched; quantify after routing
pcb_current_path.validation_gate: IPC-2152-informed/electro-thermal analysis plus prototype temperature-rise measurement required before production

provenance.connector_family: Molex Mega-Fit family page: up to 30 A per circuit, 18-10 AWG on current family page
provenance.fuse_family: Littelfuse JCASE 32 V datasheet: 60 A nominal and typical temperature-derating table
provenance.regulator_input: TI TPS546D24S supports 2.95-16 V input and 40 A per device, stackable; branch sizing here is 12 V input-side architecture only
provenance.classification: sourced family ratings + derived load allocation; exact component and PCB qualification pending
